The aoo, juce and ff_meters folders hold the third-party libraries SonoBus RP is built with, carried as
git-subrepo copies from upstream SonoBus, with small changes for SonoBus RP in each.

Opus comes as prebuilt static libraries for macOS and Windows in the mac and windows folders. On Linux, install
the Opus development package (libopus-dev on Debian and Ubuntu).
